If I issue commands to pick a specific location, my next selection shifts to that commanded location (I can turn attention to upper, right, lower, or left as commanded), so this view is under my control; selection and recoverability remain distinct and selecting an object does not by itself guarantee better recoverability.

Commands do not give me alternative next selections: regardless of which location I command, my next selection is predicted to move to the lower location. Thus I have low control over where attention will go; selecting lower does not imply improved recoverability.
